name: OpenAI Text to Speech
positioning: OpenAI's Audio API speech endpoint, offering steerable gpt-4o-mini-tts and the earlier tts-1 and tts-1-hd models behind a single request shape that many tools and SDKs already support.

pricing.model: tts-1 and tts-1-hd are billed per character; gpt-4o-mini-tts is billed per token (text input tokens plus audio output tokens), so no per-character price is published for it.
pricing.headline: tts-1 is $15 per 1M characters; tts-1-hd is $30 per 1M characters; gpt-4o-mini-tts is $0.60 per 1M text input tokens and $12.00 per 1M audio output tokens.

tiers.name: tts-1
tiers.notes: Lower latency, lower quality than tts-1-hd per OpenAI guide. Supports 9 voices. Does not accept the instructions parameter.

tiers.name: tts-1-hd
tiers.notes: Higher quality than tts-1 per OpenAI guide.

tiers.name: gpt-4o-mini-tts
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $0.60 text input, $12.00 audio output
tiers.notes: Token-billed, so cost per character depends on text and generated audio length; OpenAI states audio output is metered as tokens. Supports the instructions parameter and 13 voices; model page states max input is 2000 tokens.

pricing.freeTier: No free character or credit allowance stated on pages read. The tts-1 model page lists a Free rate-limit tier of 3 requests per minute and 200 per day.

voices.count: 13 built-in voices for gpt-4o-mini-tts (alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, onyx, nova, sage, shimmer, verse, marin, cedar); 9 for tts-1 and tts-1-hd
voices.languages: Follows Whisper language support (about 57 languages listed); voices are stated to be optimized for English
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Custom voices are limited to eligible customers (contact sales). Creating one needs a consent recording reading a prescribed phrase plus a sample of 30 seconds or less; maximum 20 voices per organization; the Text-to-Speech Supplemental Agreement applies.

compatibility.note: This is the OpenAI speech request itself: POST /v1/audio/speech with model, input, voice, optional instructions, response_format, speed (0.25 to 4.0) and stream_format (sse or audio; sse not supported on tts-1 and tts-1-hd).

licensing.attributionOrConditions: OpenAI usage policies require a clear disclosure to end users that the TTS voice is AI-generated and not a human voice.

limits.concurrency: Rate limits by usage tier. tts-1: Free 3 RPM / 200 RPD, Build 2,500 RPM, Launch 7,500 RPM, Grow 10,000 RPM. gpt-4o-mini-tts: Build 2,000 RPM / 150,000 TPM, Launch 10,000 RPM, Grow 10,000 RPM.

compliance.note: No compliance statements were found on the speech documentation or pricing pages read; OpenAI publishes security and privacy material elsewhere that was not reviewed.

strengths.claim: gpt-4o-mini-tts accepts natural-language instructions to steer accent, emotional range, intonation, speed, tone and whispering.
A single, widely adopted endpoint with first-party SDKs in many languages and support in many third-party tools.
Simple per-character pricing for tts-1 ($15) and tts-1-hd ($30) alongside a token-priced steerable model.
Streaming through chunked transfer and, on gpt-4o-mini-tts, SSE; wav or pcm recommended for fastest response.
Custom voices with a consent-recording requirement for eligible customers.

limitations.claim: Voices are stated to be optimized for English.
Custom voices are limited to eligible customers and capped at 20 voices per organization.
The instructions parameter and sse streaming are not supported on tts-1 and tts-1-hd.

stepsToMove: Base URL: change the OpenAI client base URL (for example https://api.openai.com/v1) to https://api.readaloudai.org/v1; the request shape POST /v1/audio/speech is the same.
Auth: swap the Bearer token for a ReadAloud API key.
Model and voice: model values (tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts) and OpenAI voice names (alloy, coral, marin...) map to ReadAloud model and voice ids; set these explicitly.
instructions: gpt-4o-mini-tts steering text has no guaranteed equivalent; remove it or check ReadAloud's documented behavior.
Formats: response_format values mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav and pcm; confirm the ReadAloud-supported subset. OpenAI pcm is 24 kHz 16-bit mono.
Streaming: OpenAI streams via chunked audio or stream_format=sse; ReadAloud also offers a WebSocket route if lower first-byte latency is needed.
Custom voices: OpenAI custom voice ids do not transfer.

bestFor: Developers already on the OpenAI SDK who want steerable speech or a simple per-character model without adding another vendor, and who mainly synthesize English.
unknowns: Whether the speech endpoint offers WebSocket streaming (the separate Realtime API does)
SSML support (no SSML parameter in the API reference read)
Commercial-use statement for generated audio (not found on pages read)
SOC 2, HIPAA and GDPR statements (not on pages read)
tts-1-hd price confirmed on pricing page and model page quick comparison only as a table row; rate limit rows for tts-1-hd not read
